correctness.rationale: Exact sampling without replacement sequential coupling gives a one-step marked-ball law error ≤ binom(r,2)/(M-r+1). Iteration and a stationary coupling prove (1); independent 2-state chain eigenvalue, uniform Bernoulli local CLT, Chebyshev separation and contraction prove (2)-(3). Exact rational checker passed 1,680 finite test cases; not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The regime r/N→0 is a mathematically natural, unaddressed boundary of macroscopic-swap mixing theorems. The new nonasymptotic TV comparison gives a reusable coupling principle, determines mixing center from log r rather than log N, and identifies a complete Gaussian worst-start cutoff profile with lattice-phase awareness.
